name: Deny the Songs of War

source.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

text: To keep the peace, you disrupt those who seek to break it. You can cast Deafness and 4th-rank Silence once per day each as innate spells. The tradition of these spells is the one you chose for the Nantambu Chime-Ringer Dedication feat.
